note: Painted tangent-space normal map of the kept water-target body. Silhouette aligned to the colour body: mask IoU 0.985, centroid shift under 0.02 px at 1024. Plausible OpenGL convention (up-facing green, right-facing red), folds, hood, face and droplets modelled as smooth relief. Mean inside the body (149, 142, 221) leans slightly warm against the flat 128/128/255; the build renormalizes. Background magenta overlaps pink normal directions, so the build masks with the colour body's alpha, never by keying the normal map.
method: direct pixel inspection by the builder, side by side with the target
